claims.text: Metadynamics or umbrella sampling can be employed during densification to reveal alternative sintering pathways.
The alternative pathways revealed by enhanced sampling have lower energies than conventional sintering pathways.
Revealing or using these alternative pathways will reduce the temperature required for full densification.
Loosely packed unsintered particles exhibit high activation barriers for neck formation.
Integrating a free-energy sampling method into the physical sintering process can activate densification mechanisms with lower thermal activation requirements.
Computational free-energy methods can investigate finite-temperature material energetics and properties.
Computational or experimental free-energy-landscape exploration can be performed under reduced thermal loads during sintering.
Enhanced sampling will modify particle interfaces and neck regions.
Activation of alternative mechanisms with reduced barriers will improve inter-particle bonding at lower temperatures.
Enhanced sampling reduces the effective activation energy required for particle coalescence.
A lower effective activation energy produces more efficient neck formation without high thermal energy.
The proposed method will reduce the necessary sintering temperature.
The proposed temperature reduction will maintain or improve final density and microstructural integrity.
Conventional sintering relies on high thermal energy to overcome activation barriers for densification.
Higher conventional sintering temperatures can cause microstructural coarsening.
The effectiveness of the proposed method depends on material-specific properties.
Industrial effectiveness depends on whether free-energy sampling can be scaled and integrated into sintering.

contradictions.description: The proposal alternates between treating free-energy sampling as a computational method that identifies pathways and as a physical processing intervention that directly activates pathways or lowers activation energy. Identification by simulation does not itself constitute physical activation during sintering, and the required physical perturbation is not defined.
